title: Handle consumer guarantees and statutory remedies
summary: A reviewed remedy or no-remedy decision, evidence of the authorized action or response, and unresolved disputes assigned.
outcomes: A reviewed remedy or no-remedy decision, evidence of the authorized action or response, and unresolved disputes assigned.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When a consumer reports a defect, requests a statutory remedy or disputes a warranty response.

parts.title: Record the purchase and reported problem
parts.guidance: Collect the order, seller, customer market, product or digital-service description, delivery date, defect evidence and requested remedy in the private case record. Record urgent safety concerns for a separate safety response.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

parts.title: Determine the applicable consumer remedy route
parts.guidance: Have the consumer-law owner determine applicable national rules, product scope, relevant dates and the available remedy sequence. Distinguish mandatory rights, voluntary warranties, cancellation rights and business-to-business requests; escalate uncertain facts.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

approval.reason: The step is the named human decision or human-performed work itself; policies/AGENT_POLICY.md reserves it to a human with case-specific authorization on every run.
approval.scope: Determine the applicable consumer remedy route

parts.title: Prepare a remedy proposal and fulfillment plan
parts.guidance: Prepare the proposed repair, replacement, price adjustment or refund under the reviewed instructions, with logistics, timing and evidence requirements. Record disputed eligibility and avoid making unsupported promises or treating the commercial warranty as the entire policy.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

parts.title: Approve the remedy or reasoned no-remedy decision
parts.guidance: The accountable customer-operations owner approves the specific remedy or reasoned no-remedy decision and response after required local advice. Escalate denials, repeat failures and unresolved disputes; an agent draft does not authorize a refund, settlement, waiver or denial.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

approval.reason: The step is the named human decision or human-performed work itself; policies/AGENT_POLICY.md reserves it to a human with case-specific authorization on every run.
approval.scope: Approve the remedy or reasoned no-remedy decision

parts.title: Carry out the approved repair or replacement
parts.guidance: The authorized operator sends the approved response and arranges the agreed repair or replacement through the private operating systems. Retain shipping and repair records and keep any failure or rejection open. Use the separate approved refund route for returning money.
parts.when: Only when the approved remedy is repair or replacement.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

approval.reason: The step is the named human decision or human-performed work itself; policies/AGENT_POLICY.md reserves it to a human with case-specific authorization on every run.
approval.scope: Carry out the approved repair or replacement

parts.title: Execute the specifically approved refund
parts.guidance: The authorized payment operator verifies the approved recipient, amount and payment route, checks for duplicate refunds and executes only the specifically approved refund or monetary price adjustment. Retain the payment reference, success or failure evidence and customer response; a processed refund is irreversible.
parts.when: Only when the approved remedy requires a refund or return of money.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

approval.reason: Irreversible external effect; policies/AGENT_POLICY.md requires case-specific human authorization before each run.

parts.title: Send the approved no-remedy response
parts.guidance: The authorized customer-operations owner sends the specifically approved response explaining the reviewed decision and supporting facts. Preserve the response, delivery evidence and escalation route. Keep unresolved disputes open for the qualified owner; do not add an unapproved waiver, fee or settlement.
parts.when: Only when the reviewed decision requires no repair, replacement or return of money.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.

approval.reason: Communicates externally in the company's name; policies/AGENT_POLICY.md: never invite or contact an outside party without case-specific human authorization.

parts.title: Verify resolution and review repeated defects
parts.guidance: Reconcile the customer response and any required delivery or payment evidence against the approved decision, including a decision requiring no remedy. Assign unresolved disputes and recurring defects to named owners, and review whether product, support or safety processes require correction.

execution.rationale: Local evidence preparation is reversible. Named accountable people retain specialist judgments, external actions and case-specific authorization.
